# link-preview

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/link-preview
composer require guzzlehttp/guzzle   # any PSR-18 client + PSR-17 request factory
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, ext dom/libxml/mbstring/intl/ctype/filter
- Everything returns `Rasuvaeff\Result\Result` with an enum failure; nothing throws on bad network input
- The PSR-18 client MUST NOT follow redirects (Guzzle `allow_redirects => false`): `Fetcher` follows them itself and applies `UrlPolicy` to every hop
- No DNS pinning inside the package (PSR-18 has no hook); timeouts belong to the client; close rebinding with a trusted resolving egress proxy or with `examples/pinned_client.php` (Guzzle, CURLOPT_RESOLVE to the addresses UrlPolicy checked)
- JSON-LD: the built-in `SimpleJsonLdReader` reads schema.org-context blocks only; `examples/json_ld_processor.php` is a `JsonLdReader` over `rasuvaeff/json-ld` that also handles inline contexts and aliases
- Output URLs are absolute http(s) only; text is plain (escape it when rendering)
- Source priority per field: site adapter > oEmbed (discovered) > JSON-LD > OpenGraph > Twitter Cards > HTML
- Adapter tokens (Instagram, Facebook required; Twitter optional) are constructor args, sent as Authorization headers to the API host only, never in URLs; no token = AdapterFailure::MissingToken, no request
- Namespace `Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview`

## API

```php
use GuzzleHttp\Client;
use GuzzleHttp\Psr7\HttpFactory;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Fetch\Fetcher;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Fetch\UrlPolicy;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Fetch\UserAgentMap;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Limits;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\PreviewProvider;

$provider = new PreviewProvider(
    fetcher: new Fetcher(
        client: new Client(['allow_redirects' => false, 'http_errors' => false, 'timeout' => 5.0]),
        requestFactory: new HttpFactory(),
        policy: new UrlPolicy(allowedNetworks: [], allowedPorts: [80, 443]),
        userAgents: UserAgentMap::unfurler(['t.me' => 'TelegramBot (like TwitterBot)']), // Twitterbot/1.0 everywhere: VK and others refuse the default name
        maxRedirects: 5,
        maxBodyBytes: 2_097_152,
        chainBudgetSeconds: 10.0, // checked between hops only
    ),
    extractors: null, // default: OEmbedExtractor, JsonLdExtractor, OpenGraphExtractor, TwitterCardsExtractor, HtmlFallbackExtractor
    adapters: null,   // default: AdapterRegistry::standard(); new AdapterRegistry() = off
    limits: new Limits(titleLength: 200, descriptionLength: 500, siteNameLength: 100, authorNameLength: 100, maxUrlLength: 2048, httpsImagesOnly: false),
);

$result = $provider->preview(url: 'https://example.com/article'); // Result<PageInfo, PreviewFailure>
$result = $provider->fromHtml(html: $html, pageUrl: 'https://example.com/a', charset: 'windows-1251'); // no network

$info = $result->unwrap();
$info->url; $info->title; $info->description; $info->image; $info->favicon;
$info->siteName; $info->language; $info->authorName; $info->publishedTime; $info->type; // all ?string except url, publishedTime ?DateTimeImmutable
$info->toArray();

$result->error(); // PreviewFailure: PolicyRejected, Network, TooManyRedirects, InvalidRedirect,
                  // BudgetExceeded, HttpStatus, NotHtml, TooLarge, EmptyPage
```

### UrlPolicy

```php
$policy = new UrlPolicy();
$policy->check(url: 'HTTPS://Example.COM:443/a#f'); // Result<string, UrlRejection>, ok = 'https://example.com/a'
// UrlRejection: Malformed, Scheme, Credentials, MissingHost, InvalidHost, NonCanonicalIp, Port, PrivateAddress
```

Rejected: non-http(s) schemes, credentials, ports other than 80/443 (configurable), localhost and *.localhost,
loopback/private/link-local/CGNAT/documentation/multicast/reserved IPv4 and IPv6, IPv6 carrying IPv4
(::7f00:1, ::ffff:a.b.c.d, 64:ff9b::/96, 2002::/16), decimal/hex/octal/short IPv4 spellings, control characters.
IDN hosts are converted to ASCII. Names are never resolved. `allowedNetworks` (CIDR or address list) opens private networks for dev;
`localhost` names count as 127.0.0.1.

### Fetcher

```php
$page = $fetcher->fetch(url: 'https://example.com/'); // Result<FetchedPage, FetchFailure>
// FetchedPage: url (final), body, contentType, charset, redirects
// FetchFailure: PolicyRejected, Network, TooManyRedirects, InvalidRedirect, BudgetExceeded, HttpStatus, NotHtml, TooLarge
```

Only text/html and application/xhtml+xml, 2xx, body <= maxBodyBytes. Redirects 301/302/303/307/308, `Location` resolved
against the current URL, policy checked before each request.

### Extractors and documents

```php
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Html\PageDocument;
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Extract\OpenGraphExtractor;

$document = PageDocument::parse(html: $bytes, charset: 'utf-8'); // charset: transport > BOM > <meta charset> > UTF-8
$document->title(); $document->language(); $document->baseHref();
$document->meta('og:title');      // list<string>, matches property or name, case-insensitive
$document->links('icon');         // list<string>, rel token match
$document->images();              // list<array{src, width, height}>

(new OpenGraphExtractor())->extract(document: $document, pageUrl: 'https://example.com/')
    ; // Result<Metadata, ExtractFailure::NoMetadata>
```

Implement `Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Extract\Extractor` to add a source; pass it in `extractors:` (highest priority first).
Per-field merge: the first extractor that has the field wins. Page URL = `og:url` > `canonical` > fetched URL.

### Site adapters

```php
use Rasuvaeff\LinkPreview\Adapter\AdapterRegistry;

AdapterRegistry::standard(
    twitterToken: null,          // optional
    instagramToken: '<token>',   // required for Instagram, else MissingToken
    facebookToken: '<token>',    // required for Facebook, else MissingToken
    twitchParents: ['example.com'], // needed for a Twitch embedUrl
);
```

JSON answers are parsed by `Extract\Schemas` (rasuvaeff/schema: `oEmbed()`, `wikipediaSummary()`, `rutubeVideo()`; `->arbitrary()` generates valid ones for tests);
a wrong-typed field = AdapterFailure::InvalidResponse + `$context->diagnostics()` (paths only, no values).

YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, Twitch (oEmbed), Wikipedia (REST summary), GitHub (OG, gists), Instagram, Facebook (Graph API oEmbed),
Telegram (OG + widget), VK (OG + video_ext.php), Rutube (video API). Hosts match by labels: www./m./subdomains yes,
`youtube.com.evil.example` no. Custom site: implement `Adapter` (`domains(): list<string>`, `preview(string $url, AdapterContext $context): Result<Metadata, AdapterFailure>`)
and use `$context->html($url)` / `$context->json($url, $headers)` - the only way to reach the network, always under UrlPolicy.
AdapterFailure: MissingToken, UnsupportedUrl, Unavailable, InvalidResponse. PreviewFailure also has MissingToken.
`PageInfo::$embedUrl` is an absolute http(s) player URL when the source knows one.
